meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 当你做 tool-calling agent 卡住时，它会先让你从四种症状里选一个（不呼叫 tool、参数错、loop 跑不停、还没写 schema），再按对应分支带你诊断并修 schema，不替你写代码。
howto.when: 当你提到 LLM 不呼叫 tool、参数错误、ReAct loop 跑不停等，或要设计 function schema 时接管；framework、MCP server、生产监控类问题不在它处理范围。

say.text: 我的 LLM 不呼叫 tool，帮我诊断
say.note: 它会先问你属于四种症状的哪一种

say.text: tool 被呼叫了但参数不对，schema 怎么改？
say.note: 会带你看 parameters schema 的常见问题

say.text: 帮我从零设计一个 function schema

howto.what_en: When your tool-calling agent is stuck, it first has you pick one of four symptoms (no tool call, wrong arguments, runaway loop, no schema yet), then walks you through diagnosis and schema repair; it won't write code for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say the LLM won't call your tool, args are wrong, or a ReAct loop won't stop, or you need a function schema; framework, MCP-server and observability questions are not handled.

say_en.text: My LLM won't call my tool — help me diagnose it
say_en.note: It first asks which of four symptoms you're hitting

say_en.text: The tool gets called but the arguments are wrong
Help me design a function schema from scratch
